constraints.name: stories_id_owner_unique
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (id, owner_user_id)

constraints.name: stories_owner_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: stories_parent_same_owner
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_story_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES stories(id, owner_user_id)

constraints.name: stories_parent_story_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (parent_story_id) REFERENCES stories(id)

constraints.name: stories_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: story_anchors_anchor_type_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((anchor_type = ANY (ARRAY['period'::text, 'event'::text])))

constraints.name: story_anchors_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: story_anchors_story_id_anchor_type_anchor_id_key
constraints.definition: UNIQUE (story_id, anchor_type, anchor_id)

constraints.name: story_anchors_story_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (story_id) REFERENCES stories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: story_entry_points_distinct_stories
constraints.definition: CHECK ((source_story_id <> target_story_id))

constraints.name: story_entry_points_event
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_story_id, event_id) REFERENCES story_events(story_id, event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: story_entry_points_location
constraints.definition: CHECK ((num_nonnulls(period_id, event_id) = 1))

constraints.name: story_entry_points_period
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_story_id, period_id) REFERENCES story_periods(story_id, period_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: story_entry_points_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: story_entry_points_source_story_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (source_story_id) REFERENCES stories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: story_entry_points_target_story_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (target_story_id) REFERENCES stories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: story_entry_points_unique
constraints.definition: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (source_story_id, target_story_id, period_id, event_id)

constraints.name: story_periods_no_self_parent
constraints.definition: CHECK (((parent_period_id)::text IS DISTINCT FROM (period_id)::text))

constraints.name: story_periods_parent_in_same_story
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (story_id, parent_period_id) REFERENCES story_periods(story_id, period_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: story_periods_period_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (period_id) REFERENCES periods(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: story_periods_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (story_id, period_id)

constraints.name: story_periods_story_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (story_id) REFERENCES stories(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
